Zetta Farms Experience

  • Aditya Patra

    One of THE BEST alternative investment platforms I've come across in the recent times. With the stock market dropping since the last few months, I was looking for safer and reliable investment opportunities and BANG - Came across Growpital out of the blue 🤩. The best part - the RETURNS ARE TAX FREE! Have a word with their team and you'll not be disheartened.

    Read more
  • Nagarjuna K

    Growpital is a new fintech/agritech platform that has innovatively provided investors with a new form of investment that was previously unheard of. You get to invest on farm projects and get tax free income paid out every quarter. They have taken a lot of steps to mitigate the risks and provide the investors a hassle free way to own fractions of farm portfolio. Good going team and I wish the investor base keeps growing.
    Some feedback: I would love to see a revamped website with a great UI/UX experience.
    Monthly payouts would be a lot helpful.

    Read more
  • Vipul Rawal

    Growpital allows to invest in a market which can barely has bad times. Agriproduce will always find buyers, use of technology to maximise the output is so obvious but rare

    Read more
  • Prashenjeet Biswas

    It is a unique alternative investment platform. I wish it grows big and helps investors as well as country in improving farming sector.

    Read more
  • Suman Sarkar

    Very good unique Platform for totally different type of tax free Investment.

    Read more
  • Hitesh Mangukiya

    Growpital platform has very friendly user interface. The hassle free KYC process for NRIs like me makes it more suitable platform to invest in Indian market and that's too in the agriculture sector. There weren't any platform like Growpital with high return ratio and easy to invest in diversified sectors like agriculture with such a fixed high return on investment. Investing into agriculture has never been as easy as Growpital making it unique platform saving the environment and making greener and greener.

    Read more
  • Mita Talukder

    Growpital is excellent platform to diversify your portfolio and invest in agricultural product. The platform looks genuine and very good tool for alternative investment with regular tax-free interest income.

    Read more
  • Gautam Mehra

    I love the concept. Making investing into farming using technology and reducing the friction and increasing the availability of capital is brilliant.

    Read more
